alt_key.description: Returns true if the alt key was down when the mouse event was fired.

button.description: The button number that was pressed or released (if applicable) when the mouse event was fired.

buttons.description: The buttons being pressed (if any) when the mouse event was fired.

delta_x.description: The distance that the mouse wheel has been rotated around the X axis (if applicable) when the mouse event was fired.

delta_y.description: The distance that the mouse wheel has been rotated around the Y axis (if applicable) when the mouse event was fired.

sequence_number.description: Sequence number to prevent unordered packets (UDP-like channel) from overwriting newer states.

x.description: mouse x coordinate(relative to the viewport)

y.description: mouse y coordinate(relative to the viewport)
